## Important info

This will clash with any custom skin that modifies Dark Cosmic Diana. 1 file for all chromas.

## Description

**Author**: Suriin

**Skin**: Dark Cosmic Diana

**Affects**: VFX colors

Adds matching VFX colors to every chroma, base remains the same. You need to own the chroma and choose it in champ select in order to use this mod.
